snippet.title: Forge the Fates - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Take deckbuilding to the next level. Transform your hand of cards into a tactical grid of runes. Plan, shift, and strike to unleash powerful combos and chain match-3 bonuses. Choose your hero, master their deck, and fight through deadly dungeons to face a mysterious dark overlord.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3911490/Forge_the_Fates/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:
